mainEntity.name: How long does it take to construct a Studio ADU from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for Studio ADU construction typically ranges from 6 to 12 months, encompassing design, permitting, and actual construction phases. The design process can take 1-3 months, while obtaining permits from local jurisdictions like Alameda or Berkeley often requires 2-4 months, depending on the complexity of the plans and city backlog. The actual construction phase usually lasts 3-5 months. Site-specific challenges, such as difficult terrain or existing utility issues, can extend the overall timeline. Clear communication and efficient preparation during the design phase can help streamline the permitting process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Studio ADU construction usually takes 6 to 12 months, covering design, permitting, and building. Permitting times in cities like Alameda or Berkeley can impact the overall schedule.
